description: This file defines the implementation of the WidevinePlatformDRM class, including constructor, destructor, and decrypt methods that interact with Widevine DRM components. It manages secure memory handling and decrypts media samples via a provided internal interface.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class that manages Widevine DRM operations, including decryption of media samples with handle-based and session-based approaches.

methods.description: Performs decryption using handle and session ID, converting handle to secure memory and calling the decrypt method.
